info.title: Orchestra Platform API
info.description: Endpoints for the Orchestra platform itself: the workspaces you can reach and how they are organised. Run metadata, pipelines and assets live on the Orchestra API.

get.description:
Lists the workspaces your credential can reach. An API key is issued to one workspace, so it lists that workspace alone. An OAuth token lists every workspace its user is a member of, checked at the time of the call.

Use the ids returned here as the `X-Orchestra-Account-Id` header on endpoints that act within a workspace.

200.description: The workspaces the credential can reach.

id.description: The workspace id. Pass it as the `X-Orchestra-Account-Id` header on endpoints that act within a workspace.

name.description: The workspace name as shown in Orchestra.

401.description: The credential is missing, malformed, expired or revoked.

403.description: The request came from outside the organisation's allowed IP ranges. Applies to API keys only.

ApiKey.description: An API key from your workspace settings, passed as `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. A read-only key works on endpoints that only read.

OAuth.description: An access token issued to a user by Orchestra, passed as `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`. Clients register themselves at the authorization server; there is no client secret.

scopes.orchestra:read: Read data in the workspaces you can access.
scopes.orchestra:write: Read and change data in the workspaces you can access.
